metadata.description: Claude Code plugins for development workflows: Makefile generation, CI workflow generation, CI failure diagnosis, Figma design application, semgrep security review, Go development, Protocol Buffer development, gabyx/Githooks setup, Cloudflare macOS fix, worktree and Bazel disk cleanup, language-dev skill creation, todo management, GitHub issue resolution, next-action task discovery, CLAUDE.md authoring, Jira CLI, git guardrails, macOS sandbox helpers, and Biome VCS integration

plugins.name: makefile-workflow
plugins.description: Makefile workflow skill for consistent build, lint, test, and check targets across projects

plugins.name: ci-workflow
plugins.description: GitHub Actions CI workflow generation and failure diagnosis — generate workflows that mirror Makefile targets and diagnose CI failures with targeted fixes

plugins.name: apply-figma-make
plugins.description: Apply Figma Make designs to your website pages with framework conversion

plugins.name: semgrep-review
plugins.description: Analyze semgrep findings, fix real issues, and suppress false positives with proper nosemgrep comments

plugins.name: go-dev
plugins.description: Go development skill with idiomatic patterns, testing, and build system detection

plugins.name: gabyx-githooks-setup
plugins.description: Set up shared Git hooks using gabyx/Githooks manager in any repository

plugins.name: cloudflare-macos-fix
plugins.description: Fix sharp native module installation failure on macOS Apple Silicon when setting up Cloudflare Workers projects with wrangler

plugins.name: create-lang-dev-skill
plugins.description: Create language-specific development skills by mining PR reviews, codebase conventions, and team documentation

plugins.name: todo
plugins.description: Manage a TODO.md file with priorities and task tracking

plugins.name: gh-issue-resolver
plugins.description: Resolve GitHub issues using the gh CLI, following the issue plan and acceptance criteria, with approval gates when the plan must change

plugins.name: next-action
plugins.description: Find the next highest-priority action to work on from local TODO files, source code TODO comments, GitHub issues, or other task sources

plugins.name: claude-md
plugins.description: Write effective CLAUDE.md files containing only tacit knowledge that AI agents cannot derive from the codebase

plugins.name: jira-cli
plugins.description: Jira skills for creating bugs, tasks, resolving issues, updating tickets, planning projects, and editing descriptions with proper wiki markup. Includes a hook to enforce -p/--project or -P/--parent on jira issue create.

plugins.name: git-guardrails
plugins.description: PreToolUse hooks that block dangerous git and find commands: GITHOOKS_DISABLE, GITHOOKS_SKIP_UNTRUSTED_HOOKS, githooks.skipUntrustedHooks, githooks.disable, --no-verify, bulk git add, and find -exec/-delete

plugins.name: sandbox-helpers
plugins.description: PreToolUse hook that warns about macOS sandbox TLS failures for Go CLI tools (gh, jira) and suggests workarounds

plugins.name: biome-vcs-integration
plugins.description: Configure Biome to respect .gitignore via VCS integration, avoiding format/lint errors on local-only files

plugins.name: protobuf-dev
plugins.description: Protocol Buffer development skill with style guidelines, backward compatibility, design patterns, and build system detection

plugins.name: review-push-loop
plugins.description: PreToolUse hook that redirects 'git push' to 'review-and-push-loop --output compact', which reviews unpushed commits one by one and stops on blockers. Allows escape hatches for tag pushes and branch deletes.

plugins.name: jira-close-merged
plugins.description: Scan the git log for Jira ticket IDs, transition non-Done tickets to Done, and assign unassigned tickets to the commit author using the Atlassian MCP

plugins.name: cleanup-worktree-disk
plugins.description: Reclaim macOS disk space by removing git worktrees whose PRs are merged and deleting orphaned Bazel output bases
